subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should a healthy OAuth profile be allowed to mask missing OAuth profiles in provider-level auth status, or should missing auth remain a red operator-visible state?
rationale: This is an auth-provider status contract visible in the Control UI and gateway API; automation can identify the risk, but maintainers own any intentional change to operator alert semantics.

options.title: Preserve Missing As Red
options.body: Keep missing OAuth profiles ahead of the healthy override, only suppress stale expired inventory when the effective usable OAuth credential is present, and require mixed-profile tests plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept Healthy Masks Missing
options.body: Record that mixed healthy-plus-missing OAuth inventory should report healthy or expiring, and add tests/documentation proving that intentional operator-alert behavior.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the stale badge issue needs this rollup change, the cache-refresh PR, or both together.

recommendation.title: Preserve Missing As Red
recommendation.body: Keep missing OAuth profiles ahead of the healthy override, only suppress stale expired inventory when the effective usable OAuth credential is present, and require mixed-profile tests plus real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth-health/provider-status commits make steipete the strongest available owner for the auth-provider status contract choice.
